articles.title: Egyptian construction firms surveyed sites in Gaza for 'Green Rafah' project, sources say
articles.summary:
Egyptian construction firms surveyed sites in Gaza for 'Green Rafah' project, sources say

Egyptian construction firms surveyed sites in the ruins of the southern Gaza Strip for a housing project dubbed "Green Rafah", Egyptian sources have told Middle East Eye.

A senior military source based in Egypt's North Sinai province told MEE that Egyptian engineers surveyed several areas in eastern Rafah under the supervision of the Israeli army and air force, who accompanied them throughout the process until they left the besieged Palestinian enclave.

Rafah was once home to roughly 250,000 Palestinians and known for its bustling local markets, refugee camps, and surrounding green spaces.

But since Israel launched its genocidal war on the enclave, Israeli forces have demolished at least 80 percent of the buildings in the governorate, with nearly all of its former residents now rendered homeless.

Speaking on condition of anonymity because they were not authorised to speak to the media, the source said that "the proposed neighbourhood would initially house around 20,000 Palestinians and be supervised by a multinational force expected to be deployed in several parts of the Gaza Strip under the Sharm el-Sheikh peace agreement.

Read more: Egyptian construction firms surveyed sites in Gaza for 'Green Rafah' project, sources say

articles.title: Trump says Nato 'weren't there to help' during war on Iran
articles.summary:
Trump says Nato 'weren't there to help' during war on Iran

US President Donald Trump has slammed Nato allies, saying they "weren't there to help" Washington during its war on Iran. 

"We stand with Europe despite its flaws, its weaknesses…But if they don't soon find their way, and they have to find their way, we will have no choice but to leave," he said at a campaign rally.

"We spend hundreds of billions of dollars a year on Nato protecting them, but when we said, 'Would you like to help?' 'No, thank you.' 'Oh, no thank you?' What does that mean, 'No, thank you'?"

Trump added that the US spent "so much money on Nato", adding that they "weren't there to help" and that its something Washington "can never really forget".

articles.title: How to Sell a Genocide: The Media’s Complicity in the Destruction of Gaza
articles.summary: The dispute over whether Israel’s assault on Gaza amounts to genocide has largely been settled. Amnesty International, a UN commission of inquiry and the International Association of Genocide Scholars have all reached that conclusion, as have many leading scholars of genocide. The question that remains is how the greatest political crime of our time was allowed to happen. Adam H. Johnson’s How to Sell a Genocide goes a long way to explaining it. Published by Pluto Press with a foreword by the Palestinian American human rights lawyer Noura Erakat, the book covers the crucial period from October 2023 to October 2024, when Western audiences were primed for genocide. Johnson shows that the mainstream American media did much of the priming. […]

He stressed that continued Israeli violations would not achieve their objectives but would instead strengthen the Lebanese people’s determination to defend their land and rights. Aoun said the violations were obstructing the Lebanese state’s […]

articles.title: Iran says 20 to 30 aircraft destroyed during war with US, Israel
articles.summary: Between 20 and 30 aircraft were destroyed during Iran’s war with the US and Israel, the head of the country’s state-owned flag carrier said Monday, according to the semi-official Tasnim news agency. Taher Abdolhai, CEO of Iran Air, also known as HOMA, said at a news conference that Iran needs approximately 1,000 passenger aircraft but currently has only around 300. Of those, between 130 and 140 aircraft were operational before the war, with 20 to 30 destroyed during the conflict, he said. Abdolhai also said between 70 and 80 aircraft were targeted during the war. He claimed Israeli attacks had caused particularly severe damage to Iran Air aircraft, saying some planes belonging to other operators were struck by single missiles, […]

He warned that participation in the project could carry legal and reputational consequences, including the risk of involvement in serious breaches of international law. “I want to be very clear with those considering engaging in the tendering process: we have created new powers allowing us to sanction individuals and companies involved in the construction of illegal settlements such as E1,” Miliband said. archive.security_status_cs: Izrael mobilizuje bezpečnostní složky a posiluje jednotky na Západním břehu kvůli blížícím se parlamentním volbám a rostoucímu napětí spojenému s osadnickou agresi. Írán se mezitím snaží obejít ekonomické tlaky posilováním pozemního obchodu a Irák hostí diplomatická jednání s regionálními aktéry. Humanitární situace v Gaze se dále zhoršuje v důsledku omezování pomoci ze strany WFP.
archive.security_status_en: Israel is mobilizing security forces and bolstering units in the West Bank ahead of parliamentary elections and amid rising tensions linked to settler violence. Meanwhile, Iran is attempting to bypass economic pressures by strengthening overland trade, while Iraq hosts diplomatic talks with regional actors. The humanitarian situation in Gaza continues to deteriorate due to WFP aid cuts.
archive.forecast_cs: V následujících dnech lze očekávat eskalaci politických debat před izraelskými volbami a pokračující diplomatické snahy Iráku o snížení regionálního napětí. Humanitární krize v Gaze a tlak na mezinárodní subjekty ohledně osad zůstanou v centru pozornosti.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, political debates ahead of Israeli elections and Iraq's ongoing diplomatic efforts to lower regional tensions are expected to escalate. The humanitarian crisis in Gaza and pressure on international entities regarding settlements will remain in focus.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v regionu zůstává kritická kvůli přetrvávajícím vojenským střetům a incidentům, jako je sestřelení amerického dronu MQ-9 Íránem nad Hormuzským průlivem. V Izraeli a Gaze panuje vysoké napětí spojené s politickým bojem před volbami, hrozbami bombových útoků na lety a zhoršující se humanitární krizí. Libanon mezitím obviňuje Izrael z porušování dohod a pokračujících pohraničních incidentů.
archive.security_status_en: The regional security situation remains critical due to ongoing military clashes and incidents, such as Iran's downing of a US MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz. High tension persists in Israel and Gaza amid pre-election political maneuvering, flight bomb threats, and a worsening humanitarian crisis. Meanwhile, Lebanon accuses Israel of violating framework agreements and continuing border incidents.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další diplomatické manévry a zostření rétoriky kolem íránského jaderného a vojenského programu i nadcházejících izraelských voleb. Riziko odvetných akcí v Perském zálivu a na izraelských hranicích zůstane zvýšené.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further diplomatic maneuvers and rhetoric tightening surrounding Iran's military program and upcoming Israeli elections are expected. The risk of retaliatory actions in the Persian Gulf and on Israeli borders will remain elevated.
